scripts.docker:build: docker build -t seethrough-api -f apps/api/docker/Dockerfile . && docker build -t seethrough-web -f apps/web/docker/Dockerfile . && docker build -t seethrough-agent -f apps/agent/docker/Dockerfile .
scripts.minikube:build: minikube image build -t seethrough-api -f apps/api/docker/Dockerfile . && minikube image build -t seethrough-web -f apps/web/docker/Dockerfile . && minikube image build -t seethrough-agent -f apps/agent/docker/Dockerfile .
scripts.minikube:reload: yarn minikube:build && kubectl rollout restart deployment/seethrough-api deployment/seethrough-web daemonset/seethrough-agent
